parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the faucet made of stainless steel, providing structural support for the spout and handles.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the spout and switches in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment of the faucet components.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet body to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the faucet handles (switch) made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow and temperature of the water by rotating or lifting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second faucet handle (switch) made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the other handle to control hot or cold water flow.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to adjust water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a side frame section of the faucet made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It supports one of the faucet handles and connects it to the main body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another frame section of the faucet made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the opposite handle and connects to the water supply lines.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part and does not move during use.
